name: Cinematics
state: PRs 1-4 and the intro-clock slice merged (a rule over every boss fight; no boss event slows time; the Warden, the Colossus, Aldric and the Source change phase in the fight; the arrival counts simulation ticks). PR 6 (the stage beat: one banner for phase changes, named moves and the arrival; the arrival at full speed with no letterbox, ruleset v24) in review. The owner approved the look board (2026-11-21)
summary: Boss phase changes stop the fight today: a ritual script freezes the combat step, locks the player and waits for a tap or a reading timeout (5.1-6.8 s each; the Source descent 11.5 s; Rootbound stands still for 12.9 s of a 32-37 s fight). Chapter openings take 25-39 s at Full. The plan makes every in-fight beat a boss move with at most a banner, cuts chapter openings and the finale to short cards that never wait, replaces the cinematic director and ritual layer with one stage beat, and adds a rule over every boss that no tick blocks input or the combat step.
next: Merge PR 6 and put its pictures in front of the owner; then PR 5 deletes the blocking path once Rootbound’s phase change is in. The chapter card and epilogue (PRs 7-8) follow the approved look board.
